native_containment: Sticks out of the natural ACL by {actual:.1f} mm: reduce fold depth or strand diameter (or update the ACL thickness from MRI).
strand_gap: Strands overlap: increase swing or reduce strand diameter.
block_wall: Mold wall {actual:.2f} mm is below 0.8 mm: reduce swing, fold depth or diameter.
tube_mold_feasible: Gap {actual:.2f} mm is below 1.7 mm: a tube mold is not feasible (block mold only).
bone_clearance_schematic: Scaffold touches the tibia outside the tunnel.
fiber_length: Fiber length {actual:.3f} vs target {target:.3f}: the zone is too short to hold that much braid; lower the target or lengthen the zone.
inclination: Axis angle off target: check the sagittal and coronal inputs.
mechanical_validation: Mechanics not evaluated in this release.
biological_validation: Biology not evaluated in this release.
anatomy_regen: Rebuild hash differs: nondeterministic geometry or edited inputs between passes.
attachment_on_bone: {actual} footprint rays missed the bone surface: shrink the footprint domain or move its center.
frame_continuity: Centerline frames flip (min dot {actual:.4f}): add intermediate control points to smooth the path.
mesh_valid_anatomy: Anatomy mesh audit failed: see validation_report.json for the defect counts.
bone_penetration_midbody: Mid-body surface inside bone (fraction {actual:.4f} over 0.02): check centerline clearance and section widths.
anatomy_self_intersection: {actual} intersecting triangle pairs: smooth section keys or reduce the fan rotation.
export_scale: Export bounds differ by {actual:.3f} mm: check STL units and float precision.
bundle_inside_acl: Bundle surface reaches {actual:.2f} of the ACL envelope (limit 1.00): check bundle offsets (anatomical mode).
stump_closure: Stump cut faces have {actual} open edges: lower the tear obliquity or move the tear location.
